_comment: Konomi film tag-pool adapter config — the tunable knobs for level gating. Decided 2026-07-24 (user); floor 55 is the STARTING value for MVP, revise freely. Per-section floor tuning and Map restructuring deliberately deferred until seen live in production.

rating.display: raw TMDB vote_average — MVP default per user 2026-07-24
rating.post_mvp: user-owned custom rating mechanism (separate from and after MVP; era-defining ships at MVP with the locked §8 recipe)

reception_mvp._comment: ALL 14 reception tags ship at MVP (user 2026-07-24). 13 are per-film raw-field thresholds; era-defining is the one corpus-wide computation (locked §8 recipe: m=1000 shrink, top slice within decade, vc floor). Computed at promote, never at ingest. Sometimes-layer: films with no qualifying tag show genres only.
reception_mvp.era-defining: LOCKED §8 recipe: shrunk = (va*vc + 6.5*1000)/(vc+1000), top slice within release decade, vc floor per §8
reception_mvp.stacking: box-office ROI bands mutually exclusive; blockbuster + big-budget + one ROI band may co-occur; all reception tags stack freely otherwise

sagas._comment: Part 3 BANKED (user, 2026-07-24). Measured: 2,170 films (25.4%) carry belongs_to_collection; 1,059 distinct collections.
sagas.source: belongs_to_collection — ids + names embedded in raw payloads (zero new requests at MVP; /collection endpoint post-MVP for artwork + complete part lists)
sagas.singletons: 465 card-only: saga name displays on the film card as a read-only value, DISABLED as a tag (not draggable/selectable — as a recommend input it could only return the film itself); floor is corpus-relative so future imports can graduate a singleton to the shelf (delta report will surface it)
sagas.grouping: ONE Sagas home: the named-saga shelf (search + rank — top ~20 by film count, search reaches all 594) beside the 5 franchise-mechanics tag-kw (sequel/prequel/remake/reboot/spin off)
sagas.label: strip trailing ' Collection' from TMDB names (James Bond Collection -> James Bond)
sagas.levels: all levels including moviegoer (franchises are the most mainstream handle)
sagas.promote: each >=2 saga promotes as a tag (type: saga, members = its corpus film ids) — add-tag slots, recommend, and random work with zero engine special-casing
sagas.known_behavior: two sagas in two slots => empty result set (franchises share no films) — covered by existing empty-result UX

rules.universal_floor: one floor for all sections at film buff; per-section tuning deferred post-launch
rules.empty_section_hidden: a section with zero tags above the active floor is not selectable in the UI (it would be empty), never an error
rules.zero_kw_fallback: films with no tag-kw surface on genres + reception at every level — intended (315 corpus films have no TMDB keywords at all; 23 carry only sub-floor strings)
rules.heat: rarity/heat is percentile WITHIN section, never a global percentage (measured guardrail)
rules.section_order: display order = pillar_tree order in master.json
rules.tag_terminology: tags = collective (genres + reception + tag-kw); tag-kw when the keyword layer needs distinguishing
